identity_note: Matched particlehealth.com, the New York healthcare-data interoperability API company (LinkedIn HQ New York, NY), which fits the 'Medical Health Records' sector label. Not to be confused with Particle (IoT hardware) or particle-therapy results that dominate generic searches.

profile.name: Particle Health
profile.description: API platform that pulls patient medical records from national health-information networks and turns them into FHIR/C-CDA data and clinical insights, sold to value-based care organizations, payers, health systems and digital-health developers.
profile.founder: Troy Bannister and Dan Horbatt (co-founders). Jason Prestinario has been CEO since May 2023 and runs the company; Bannister's LinkedIn now shows him at Onboard AI.
profile.funding_detail: About $39M-$49M raised in total (Caplight $39.3M; CB Insights $49.3M over 8 rounds). $12M Series A (early 2020, led by Menlo Ventures); $25M Series B (July 2022, led by Canvas Ventures with Menlo, Story Ventures, PruVen Capital); CB Insights also lists a $10M Series B-II on Dec 10, 2024 with undisclosed investors. No 2026 round found.
profile.headcount: 11-50 on LinkedIn (41 employees listed on the LinkedIn page as of 2026-10-08); Built In lists 40
profile.past_completed_deals: None found. Particle Health is a data-interoperability platform, not an acquirer; no acquisitions page or acquisition press.
profile.open_role: No open roles found as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Not an acquirer · no open roles
verdict.detail: Small, VC-backed health-data API company whose antitrust case against Epic is in discovery. It has no deal history and no corp-dev seat; the CEO, Jason Prestinario, makes the calls.

caveats: Open roles: the careers page loads, but its embedded Greenhouse board ('particlehealth') returns 'can't find that page' and no Ashby or Lever board exists, so no postings are live
Founder: Troy Bannister's LinkedIn now shows Onboard AI; he moved to Chief Strategy Officer in 2023 and appears to have left. Dan Horbatt's current role is not confirmed
Funding: totals disagree, Caplight $39.3M vs CB Insights $49.3M; the Dec 2024 $10M Series B-II comes only from aggregators
Headcount: LinkedIn shows 41 (11-50 band), down from the ~50 in the prior pass; Wellfound still shows 51-200
Litigation: Sept 2025, the SDNY court let Particle's monopolization claims against Epic proceed to discovery; no later ruling found
Ownership: independent and VC-backed; no parent or PE sponsor found
